clips.title: The story
paras: Across the Hillsbrad forests, rare, virulent Creeper Ichor is harvested from moss creepers. The Royal Apothecary Society in Tarren Mill seeks it as a biological agent for formulating novel plagues against the living.

In Tarren Mill, Apothecary Lydon seeks natural toxins and biological catalysts to craft deadly new toxins and eradicate the surrounding human population. The clean air and vibrant life of the foothills offend him. Among the forest’s giant arachnids, mature moss creepers hold an elusive ichor that makes an ideal base for his Elixir of Suffering. Mixed with other reagents, including gray bear tongues, the fluid helps the Forsaken perfect their lethal alchemy.
